comparison.objective: Collect three litter items with a trigger-operated reacher and place them in a bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Aim a long tool while operating its trigger and transporting grasped objects.
comparison.success_condition: All litter is stationary in the bin without direct gripper contact or tool loss.
comparison.reason: Remote trigger-tool pickup does not test orientation-dependent granular flow or screen-mediated material separation.
